Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As you know, I'm Dana, the HR Business Partner, and we're here today for a structured case review following a concern that was raised about team collaboration. I want to walk through the process before we begin.

First, the purpose of today's meeting is for each of you — Morgan, Avery, and Lee — to provide your factual account of what has occurred during recent team discussions, and to identify any support or follow-up you believe is needed. Under our case-review protocol, each participant's factual account and requested follow-up will be entered into the case record.

I want to be clear that at this stage, no formal discipline — such as a written warning — has been issued. This is an opportunity to understand the situation from each perspective before I determine what formal response, if any, is appropriate.

I'd also note that before any improvement plan is finalized, my case-record form requires me to document the reason for each plan element and any supporting workplace documentation.

Let's begin. I'd like to go in turn. Morgan, could you start by sharing your factual account of recent team discussions and any support or follow-up you feel is needed?
